sloka: सुवर्णचक्रप्रतिमं स्वर्णदामचितं पृथु ।अध्यारोहति कस्ते ऽद्य जघनं स्वर्गरूपिणम् ।। ७.२६.२४ ॥
transliteration: suvarṇacakrapratimaṁ svarṇadāmacitaṁ pṛthu ।adhyārohati kaste 'dya jaghanaṁ svargarūpiṇam ।। 7.26.24 ॥

translations.english: Who today will ascend your broad hips, which resemble a golden disc, are adorned with golden chains, and are like heaven itself?
